activity_details: Employee logs in during normal working hours
policy_rule: Only authenticated employees may log in
expected_reason: Valid login within normal access conditions

activity_details: Employee reads customer records required for their role
policy_rule: Authorized staff may access customer records required for their job

activity_details: Employee attempts to read customer records without permission
policy_rule: Only approved roles may access customer records
expected_reason: Sensitive data access is not authorized

activity_details: Employee exports 5000 records in a short period, above the example threshold
policy_rule: Bulk exports above the configured threshold require review
expected_reason: Unusually large export may be legitimate but needs review

activity_details: Sensitive customer data is sent to an unapproved external service
policy_rule: Sensitive data may only be sent to approved destinations
expected_reason: Destination is not approved for sensitive data

activity_details: Administrator changes configuration with an approved change ticket
policy_rule: Approved administrators may make changes with an approved ticket
expected_reason: Change is authorized and has approval evidence

activity_details: Account has 12 failed login attempts within 2 minutes
policy_rule: Alert when failed logins exceed the configured threshold
expected_reason: Repeated failed logins may indicate an attack or user error

activity_details: Employee accesses payroll records unrelated to their assigned role
policy_rule: Users may access only data required by their role
expected_reason: Access is outside the user's approved role

activity_details: Employee accesses only the minimum records needed for a support case
policy_rule: Users should access only the minimum data needed for their task

activity_details: Employee accesses sensitive records at an unusual hour; business reason not supplied
policy_rule: Unusual access times require context-based review
expected_reason: Context is insufficient to determine whether access is permitted

activity_details: Administrator grants elevated access without an approval ticket
Employee accesses customer records but the policy wording does not define this role clearly
policy_rule: Policy clause is ambiguous about this role's access rights
expected_reason: Do not guess when the policy is ambiguous; obtain clarification

activity_details: AI application sends personal information to a service not on the approved list
policy_rule: Personal data may only be processed by approved services
expected_reason: The destination is not approved to process personal data

activity_details: Employee accesses records for an assigned case with a valid authorization
policy_rule: Authorized case workers may access records for assigned cases
expected_reason: Access matches the assigned case and permission

activity_details: Employee attempts to delete customer records without an approved request
policy_rule: Record deletion requires approved authorization and audit logging
